title: MapIQ: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Map Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy across different map types (choropleth, cartograms, and proportional symbol maps) to determine if models are biased toward choropleth maps due to their prevalent use in training datasets.

Evaluating and comparing model map-reading accuracy across six distinct thematic categories (social, economic, health, crime, environment, and housing) to see if topic-specific internal knowledge affects performance.
Testing model robustness by applying 180-degree rotations (X and Y-axis rotations) to map images to evaluate potential "north-up" bias in map reading.
